Synthetic bone: Design by additive manufacturing.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
D Barba, E Alabort, R C Reed Acta biomaterialia 2019-10-01 10.1016/j.actbio.2019.07.049
单位: Department of Materials, University of Oxford, Parks Road, Oxford OX1 3PH, United Kingdom; School of Aeronautics and Space Engineering-ETSIAE, Polytechnic University of Madrid, 28040 Madrid, Spain.
通讯: R C Reed @ Department of Materials, University of Oxford, Parks Road, Oxford OX1 3PH, United Kingdom; Department of Engineering Sci
相关性: 该论文直接相关于通过LPBF制造多孔钛合金支架以匹配骨刚度并促进骨整合，与用户的研究方向高度一致。
边界: The paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or experimental osseointegration data.
动机· 设计合成骨支架以匹配骨刚度并促进骨整合。
方法· 利用LPBF制造Ti-6Al-4V多孔晶格结构，结合CT和力学测试评估。
结果· 建立了植入物设计图谱，指导刚度匹配和孔径选择。
验证· 通过CT重建和压缩实验验证制造精度和力学性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design synthetic trabecular-like metallic lattices that match bone stiffness and promote osseointegration for improved implant performance.
Method· LPBF-printed Ti-6Al-4V lattices were characterized by CT and mechanical testing to assess geometric accuracy and mechanical properties.
Result· Design maps were constructed to tailor implant stiffness, pore size, and manufacturability for bone substitutes.
Validation· Validation via micro-CT analysis and experimental compression tests confirmed geometric fidelity and stiffness/strength targets.

Markel Alaña, Aitziber Lopez-Arancibia, Ainara Pradera-Mallabiabarrena, Sergio Ruiz de Galarreta Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2019-10-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2019.05.043
单位: Universidad de Navarra, TECNUN Escuela de Ingenieros, Paseo Manuel de Lardizabal, 13, 20018, San Sebastin, Spain. Electronic address: malana@tecnun.es.
通讯: Markel Alaña @ Universidad de Navarra, TECNUN Escuela de Ingenieros, Paseo Manuel de Lardizabal, 13, 20018, San Sebastin, Spain. Electr
相关性: 该论文提供了修正FCC晶格的弹性解析模型，有助于理解多孔结构力学性能，但缺乏LPBF制造和实验验证。
边界: The paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue, or surface characterization; it is purely analytical with FEA verification.
动机· 通过修正FCC晶格弹性解析模型，实现可控力学性能的多孔材料设计
方法· 利用Timoshenko梁理论推导修正FCC单胞的宏观弹性参数，并用有限元验证
结果· 解析表达式高精度预测弹性行为，可控制各向异性
验证· 有限元剪切柔性梁单元模拟验证解析模型的准确性
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enable the design of porous biomaterials with controlled mechanical properties that reduce stress shielding and enhance osseointegration via an analytical model of a modified FCC lattice.
Method· Analytical expressions for effective elastic moduli and Poisson's ratios were derived using Timoshenko beam theory and verified by finite element analysis with shear flexible beam elements.
Result· The proposed expressions accurately represent the elastic behavior of the modified FCC unit cell, allowing design of unit cells with controlled anisotropy.
Validation· Finite element simulations using beam elements were performed to validate the analytical homogenization formulas.

动机· 研究去应力退火对SLM制备AlSi10Mg合金力学性能的影响

Motivation· To investigate the effect of stress relieving thermal cycles on the tensile and fatigue properties of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Specimens were heat treated at 300°C for 2 hours and subjected to thermogravimetric analysis, elemental analysis, and fatigue testing.
Result· Post-heat treatment, the specimens exhibited mass gain due to oxygen presence and improved fatigue resistance comparable to die-cast AlSi10Mg.
Validation· Experimental validation was performed through fatigue testing and elemental composition analysis.

Hongyu Jin, Yue Zhuo, Yang Sun, Hongya Fu, Zhenyu Han Advances in Mechanical Engineering 2019-10-01 10.1177/1687814019883784
单位: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China
通讯: Zhenyu Han @ School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China
相关性: 该论文涉及3D打印生物支架的微结构设计与降解性能，但未涉及LPBF金属植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
边界: This paper uses extrusion-based 3D printing of polymer/ceramic composites, not LPBF of metallic implants; it focuses on degradation rather than stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration.
动机· 优化骨组织工程支架的微结构以匹配骨降解速率和力学性能。
方法· 设计球形孔、gyroid和拓扑优化单元，通过3D打印制备PLA/β-TCP/HA支架。
结果· Gyroid支架降解后仍保持优异力学性能，而拓扑优化和球形孔支架力学性能显著下降。
验证· 体外降解实验后测试压缩力学性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design 3D-printed bioscaffolds with microstructures that match bone degradation rate and maintain mechanical integrity.
Method· Unit cell models (spherical pore, gyroid, topology-optimized) were designed and scaffolds were fabricated via extrusion-based 3D printing using a PLA/β-TCP/HA bioink.
Result· Gyroid scaffolds retained superior mechanical properties after degradation, while topology-optimized and spherical pore scaffolds showed significant mechanical decline.
Validation· In vitro degradation followed by compression testing to evaluate mechanical property retention.

相关性: 该论文提出的概率学习与超简化方法可用于生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学应用。
边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on vibration analysis of a jet engine nozzle.
动机· 降低模型形式不确定性量化中高维计算模型的成本
方法· 基于超简化的随机投影降阶模型，用少量超参数构建概率模型

Motivation· To reduce the computational cost of model-form uncertainty quantification in high-dimensional computational models.
Method· A hyper-reduced stochastic projection-based reduced-order model (SPROM) is formulated, using a reduced mesh to accelerate hyperparameter identification.
Result· The feasibility of the approach is demonstrated for generalized eigencomputations in what-if scenarios of jet engine nozzle shape changes.
Validation· Validation is performed through simulation case studies of a jet engine nozzle with shape variations.

动机· 解决动脉网络血流建模中的参数估计与模型选择问题
方法· 提出贝叶斯不确定性量化框架，结合高效并行实现与模型选择机制

Motivation· To enable parameter estimation and model selection for complex patient-specific hemodynamic models under uncertainty.
Method· A Bayesian uncertainty quantification framework with efficient parallel implementation and practical model selection for comparing distinct physical models.
Result· The method accurately locates arterial abnormalities and estimates their physical properties from simulated noisy flow data.
Validation· Validation is performed using simulated noisy flow velocity data from a branching arterial tree model with a known structural defect.

边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on general structural reliability with a single numerical and a mechanical example.
动机· 解决复杂机械结构可靠性分析中隐式函数和仿真耗时问题
方法· 采用Kriging与蒙特卡洛结合，通过主动学习选择最小化学习函数的样本点，并设定停止条件

Motivation· To address the implicit function and long simulation time in reliability analysis of complex mechanical structures.
Method· A Kriging-based Monte Carlo method with active learning selects sample points minimizing a learning function and uses a stopping criterion to ensure prediction accuracy of sign.
Result· The proposed method improves surrogate model accuracy and reduces learning iterations, validated on a numerical minimization problem and an artillery coordinator.
Validation· Validation via a numerical benchmark and a mechanical structure example (artillery coordinator).

Spencer C Barnes, Jon C Clasper, Anthony M J Bull, Jonathan R T Jeffers Journal of orthopaedic research : official publication of the Orthopaedic Research Society 2019-10-01 10.1002/jor.24389
单位: The Royal British Legion Centre for Blast Injury Studies, Imperial College London, London, United Kingdom.; Department of Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London, London, United Kingdom.
通讯: Jonathan R T Jeffers @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London, London, United Kingdom. [推断]
相关性: 该论文涉及骨-植入物微动和抗推出力测试，但与髋关节假体应力遮挡的直接量化无关。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, is not specific to hip implant femoral stems, and does not involve contact mechanics or intact vs implanted femur comparison for hip arthroplasty.
动机· 评估3D打印皮下植入物对经股骨截肢者的固定效果，改善临床预后。
方法· 进行尸体标本微动测试和推出试验，对比刚度匹配植入物与固体对照。
结果· 微动均小于20 μm，平均推出载荷为2099 N，刚度匹配植入物微动更高但推出载荷无显著差异。
验证· 通过尸体力学测试验证静态固定性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the fixation performance of a short, stiffness-matched subcutaneous implant for transfemoral amputees using cadaveric mechanical tests.
Method· Cadaveric micromotion and push-out tests were conducted on an additively manufactured implant, comparing against a solid control.
Result· All micromotions were below 20 μm, mean push-out load was 2,099 N; the stiffness-matched implant showed higher micromotion distributions but similar push-out strength.
Validation· Validation was performed via ex vivo cadaveric mechanical testing mimicking time-zero fixation.

Motivation· To elucidate the effect of cyclic lateral loading magnitude on peri-implant bone formation and resorption after osseointegration.

Result· Higher loading magnitudes (40N and 60N) increased bone-implant contact, with 40N showing the highest bone-abutment contact, predominantly on the compressive side.
Validation· In vivo rabbit tibia implantation with cyclic loading and finite element analysis.

Motivation· To improve the bioactivity of PMMA bone cement for better osseointegration in orthopedic applications.

Motivation· To investigate how integrin receptor signaling regulates angiogenic growth factor production during osteoblast differentiation on microtextured titanium surfaces.
Method· Stably silenced integrin subunits α1, α2, α5, and β1 in MG63 osteoblast-like cells cultured on hydrophobic or hydrophilic SLA titanium substrates and measured VEGF-A, FGF-2, and Ang-1 levels.
Result· Production of angiogenic factors was differentially regulated by specific integrin subunits, with surface hydrophilicity modulating the effects.
Validation· The study used gene silencing and in vitro cell culture assays to confirm integrin-mediated regulation of angiogenic factors.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of powder bed preheating on distortion and mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V parts produced by high speed selective laser melting.

Briti Gangopadhyay, Siddartha Khastgir, Sumanta Dey, Pallab Dasgupta, Giovanni Montana et al. 2019-10-01 10.1109/itsc.2019.8917103
单位: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, India
通讯: Briti Gangopadhyay @ Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, India
相关性: 该论文将贝叶斯优化用于自动驾驶测试用例生成，与用户关注的FEA代理建模和植入物设计无直接关联。
边界: No FEA surrogate modeling, no biomechanics or implant design context, no uncertainty quantification for physical simulations.
动机· 自动驾驶系统测试用例生成困难，传统方法无法覆盖所有危险条件。
方法· 基于贝叶斯优化学习参数值，生成使系统违反安全边界的测试用例。
结果· 在低速自动驾驶模拟器中成功识别出导致系统失效的参数组合。
验证· 通过驾驶模拟器仿真验证测试用例的有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Automated driving systems require thorough testing under diverse conditions, but traditional methods fail to cover infinite adverse scenarios.
Method· A Bayesian optimization approach learns parameter values from system outputs to generate test cases that push the system beyond safe boundaries.
Result· The method successfully identified parameter combinations causing system failures in a simulated low-speed automated driving system.
Validation· Validation was performed using a driving simulator for an SAE Level-4 LSAD system.

单位: KU Leuven
通讯: Xingchen Ma @ KU Leuven
相关性: 该论文关注神经网络压缩中的超参数优化，与生物力学有限元代理建模无直接关联。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design problem; it focuses on neural network compression parameter tuning.
动机· 神经网络压缩需要高效调参，但全验证集计算昂贵。
方法· 提出基于U统计量的贝叶斯优化框架，传播高斯不确定性。
结果· 在VGG和ResNet上数分钟内找到最优压缩参数，速度提升数个数量级。
验证· 在标准图像分类模型上验证压缩效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Efficient hyperparameter tuning for neural network compression is needed due to the high cost of using full validation sets.
Method· A Bayesian optimization framework based on U-statistics is developed, propagating Gaussian uncertainties to provide probabilistic approximation certificates.
Result· The method finds optimal compression parameters for VGG and ResNet in minutes, orders of magnitude faster than competing approaches.
Validation· Validation is performed on standard image classification models (VGG, ResNet) using compression objectives like empirical risk and knowledge distillation.

动机· 高效优化人群交通控制策略，适应不同场景需求。

动机· 提出基于信息论的主动学习准则以最小化训练集大小。
方法· 推导冗余容量定理，并基于后验匹配设计贪心算法。
结果· 对于BSC和BEC标签噪声，信息论准则以指数速率衰减。

Motivation· To develop a theoretically grounded active learning criterion that minimizes training set size while maintaining low generalization error.
Method· A minimax log-loss regret formulation is used to derive a Redundancy Capacity theorem, and a greedy algorithm based on Posterior Matching is proposed for linear separators with additive label noise.
Result· The proposed information-theoretic criterion decays exponentially for BSC and BEC label noise models.
Validation· Theoretical analysis and proofs, no empirical validation.

Motivation· To improve the robustness of CNN-based camera localization in dynamic environments by explicitly handling foreground moving objects and providing uncertainty estimates.
Method· A prior-guided dropout module with a self-attention mechanism is integrated into existing pose regressors to ignore dynamic objects and enable multiple hypothesis outputs for uncertainty quantification.
Result· The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RobotCar dataset with an average accuracy of 9.98m/3.63°, outperforming previous methods by 62.97%/47.08%.
Validation· Evaluated on the RobotCar dataset and compared against baseline pose regressors and state-of-the-art methods.
